coordinate_space: design zones are approximate; camera is not reconstructed
market_evidence: braille on the front face; "film-coated tablets"; pack of 4

front_face_measurement.order: TL, TR, BR, BL — the order render_driver.py emits, so src/deskew.flatten_face reads it unchanged
front_face_measurement.method: set by hand against a coordinate overlay, then verified by rectifying and inspecting; the top edge was 40px too high on the first pass and included the lid
front_face_measurement.note: shares are of the RECTIFIED front face only, unlike color_zones above which count the whole photograph including background
front_face_measurement.corner_note: clean; the whole face and nothing else

design_measurement.method: rectified with src/deskew.flatten_face from hand-set corners; type split by value < 0.35, remainder k-means k=3 labelled by saturation and value, not by hue
design_measurement.note: shares are of the FRONT FACE. The `color_zones` block counts the whole photograph, background included, and the two are not comparable.
